title: build(deps-dev): bump @tailwindcss/postcss 4.3.3 -> 4.3.5 in /packages/client
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. @tailwindcss/postcss is a devDependency, but it GENERATES the production CSS, so its output ships even though the package does not. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid.
behavior_change: Production CSS bytes change; computed styles measured identical in Chromium. Clean installs (npm ci) of origin/main 3291df78 and this branch, then vite build on both: 199 vs 199 dist files, same inventory. After normalizing Vite content hashes in file names and references, 195/199 files are identical; the 4 that differ are all CSS (index, ArtStudioBracing, ArtStudioInlay, PipelineLabView; index.css 77,992 -> 78,058 bytes, the other three unchanged in size). Every difference is one of four kinds: (1) the license banner 'tailwindcss v4.3.3' -> 'v4.3.5'; (2) empty var() fallbacks gain a space, var(--tw-blur,) -> var(--tw-blur, ), in .transform, .filter, .backdrop-filter, .ring/.ring-1, focus:ring-1/2, font-variant-numeric (Tailwind 4.3.4 #20373; same empty fallback per spec); (3) .rounded-full border-radius 3.40282e38px -> 2147483647px: the source is still calc(infinity * 1px) in both versions, the serialization comes from @tailwindcss/node 4.3.5's optimize step (lightningcss 1.33.0 alone still emits 3.40282e38px), and both exceed any element so the radius is clamped to a full pill; (4) the @property fallback guard @supports ... not (margin-trim:inline) -> not (margin-trim:block) (Tailwind 4.3.4 #20569), which only affects Safari (Chromium and Firefox fail the -webkit-hyphens / -moz-orient halves of that condition either way): it stops applying the --tw-* initial-value fallback in Safari versions that dropped margin-trim:inline. Computed-style A/B in Chromium 1243 (headless): every simple class selector in each stylesheet mounted in a fixed 300x200 host, all computed properties compared, old CSS vs new CSS: index 724 classes / 528,539 property values / 0 differ; ArtStudioBracing 477/0; ArtStudioInlay 477/0; PipelineLabView 3,816/0. Control: forcing .rounded-full to 4px in the new CSS is detected (8 differing values). Not covered: Safari/WebKit rendering (the margin-trim change is Safari-only and intended as a fix), pseudo-class states (:focus rules differ only by the var() fallback space), and real-page screenshots. Lockfile: Dependabot's lockfile also moved three packages Tailwind does not require (@jridgewell/resolve-uri 3.1.2->3.1.3, enhanced-resolve 5.24.5->5.27.0, graceful-fs 4.2.11->4.2.12; @tailwindcss/node 4.3.5 floors enhanced-resolve at ^5.24.5, already satisfied) and flipped `peer` on 16 unchanged-version entries; all 19 entries reverted to main's, per main's convention since ec88eedd. npm ci accepts the rebuilt lockfile unmodified.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares @tailwindcss/postcss ^4.3.5 (was ^4.3.3). packages/client/package-lock.json (405 -> 406 entries) moves exactly the closure Tailwind 4.3.5 requires: @tailwindcss/postcss, @tailwindcss/node, @tailwindcss/oxide + its 12 platform binaries, tailwindcss 4.3.3 -> 4.3.5; lightningcss + its 10 platform binaries 1.32.0 -> 1.33.0 (exact pin by @tailwindcss/node); @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi bundled deps (@emnapi/core, @emnapi/runtime, @emnapi/wasi-threads, @napi-rs/wasm-runtime, @tybys/wasm-util); ADDED nested @tailwindcss/node/node_modules/magic-string 1.4.5 (@tailwindcss/node now needs ^1.1.0; the root magic-string 0.30.21 used by vue/vitest is untouched); @jridgewell/sourcemap-codec 1.5.5 -> 1.6.0 (forced: magic-string 1.4.5 needs ^1.6.0; all other dependents accept 1.6.0).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. The bump is open as PR #491 and both CBSP21 gates fail there for want of a manifest of its own; this is that manifest.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No source file, no CSS source, no PostCSS/Vite config. Root magic-string 0.30.21, postcss 8.5.32, enhanced-resolve 5.24.5, graceful-fs 4.2.11, @jridgewell/resolve-uri 3.1.2 and all `peer` flags stay as on main. 195/199 dist files are byte-identical after hash normalization; no JS logic changes. @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi now declares engines node ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=23.5.0 and drops its cpu restriction; the client's engines floor (^20.19.0 || >=22.22.2) and CI (Node 22) are inside that range, and the WASM fallback only loads when no native binding exists.

manual_verifications: Lockfile was enumerated by parsing both JSON trees, NOT by reading the diff view (PR #296 precedent).
A devDependency label does not make this build-only: the generated CSS ships. The test is therefore the built CSS, not the package's runtime footprint.
No spec renders compiled Tailwind CSS, so CI's green tests do not exercise this change; the dist diff and computed-style A/B are the only rendering evidence.

files.intent: Resolved tree for the bump, limited to the closure Tailwind 4.3.5 requires; Dependabot's unforced transitive upgrades and peer-flag churn dropped.
files.behavior_change: Tailwind 4.3.3 -> 4.3.5 family, lightningcss 1.32.0 -> 1.33.0 family, oxide-wasm32-wasi bundled deps, nested magic-string 1.4.5 added, @jridgewell/sourcemap-codec 1.5.5 -> 1.6.0. No other entry differs from origin/main 3291df78.
